items.source: the generated variable name
items.translation: 生成的变量名

items.source: method - the method to generate a variable name for
items.translation: method - 用于生成变量名的方法

items.source:
As of 5.0 this method supports reactive types:
Mono<com.myapp.Product> becomes "productMono"
Flux<com.myapp.MyProduct> becomes "myProductFlux"
Observable<com.myapp.MyProduct> becomes "myProductObservable"
items.translation:
自 5.0 版本起，此方法支持响应式类型： Mono<com.myapp.Product> 变为 "productMono"
Flux<com.myapp.MyProduct> 变为 "myProductFlux"
Observable<com.myapp.MyProduct> 变为 "myProductObservable"

items.source: value - the return value (may be null if not available)
items.translation: value - 返回值（如果不可用，可能为 null）

items.source:
For example:
com.myapp.Product becomes "product"
com.myapp.MyProduct becomes "myProduct"
com.myapp.UKProduct becomes "UKProduct"
items.translation:
例如：
com.myapp.Product 变为 "product"
com.myapp.MyProduct 变为 "myProduct"
com.myapp.UKProduct 变为 "UKProduct"

items.source: For arrays the pluralized version of the array component type is used. For Collections an attempt is made to 'peek ahead' to determine the component type and return its pluralized version.
items.translation: 对于数组，使用数组组件类型的复数形式。对于 `Collection`，会尝试“向前查看”以确定组件类型并返回其复数形式。

items.source: Return an attribute name qualified by the given enclosing Class. For example the attribute name 'foo' qualified by Class 'com.myapp.SomeClass' would be 'com.myapp.SomeClass.foo'
items.translation: 返回由给定包含的 Class 限定的属性名称。例如，由 Class 限定的属性名称 'foo'；'com.myapp.SomeClass' 限定后的结果为 'com.myapp.SomeClass.foo'。

items.source: Convert Strings in attribute name format (for example, lowercase, hyphens separating words) into property name format (camel-case). For example transaction-manager becomes "transactionManager".
items.translation: 将属性名格式的 `String`（例如，使用连字符分隔单词的小写形式）转换为属性名格式（驼峰式）。例如，`transaction-manager` 变为 `"transactionManager"`。

items.source: Determine the conventional variable name for the return type of the given method, taking the generic collection type, if any, into account, falling back on the given actual return value if the method declaration is not specific enough, for example, Object return type or untyped collection.
items.translation: 确定给定方法返回类型的约定变量名，同时考虑泛型集合类型（如有），如果方法声明不够具体（例如 `Object` 返回类型或未指定类型的集合），则回退到给定的实际返回值。

items.source:
Provides methods to support various naming and other conventions used
throughout the framework. Mainly for internal use within the framework.
items.translation: 提供方法以支持框架中使用的各种命名和其他约定。主要用于框架内部。

items.source:
Determine the conventional variable name for the return type of the
given method, taking the generic collection type, if any, into account.
items.translation: 确定给定方法的返回类型的约定变量名，同时考虑任何泛型集合类型。

items.source: value - the value to generate a variable name for
items.translation: value - 用于生成变量名的值

items.source: parameter - the method or constructor parameter
items.translation: parameter - 方法或构造函数参数

items.source: resolvedType - the resolved return type of the method
items.translation: resolvedType - 方法的解析返回类型

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev

items.source: Return an attribute name qualified by the given enclosing Class.
items.translation: 返回由给定包含的Class限定的属性名。

items.source: Convert Strings in attribute name format (for example, lowercase, hyphens separating words) into property name format (camel-case).
items.translation: 将属性名称格式的 `String`（例如，使用连字符分隔单词的小写形式）转换为属性名称格式（驼峰式）。

items.source: Determine the conventional variable name for the supplied Object based on its concrete type.
items.translation: 根据提供的 `Object` 的具体类型，确定其常规变量名。

items.source: Determine the conventional variable name for the return type of the given method, taking the generic collection type, if any, into account, falling back on the given return value if the method declaration is not specific enough, for example, Object return type or untyped collection.
items.translation: 确定给定方法返回类型的约定变量名，同时考虑泛型集合类型（如有），如果方法声明不够具体（例如 `Object` 返回类型或未指定类型的集合），则回退到给定的返回值。

items.source:
Determine the conventional variable name for the given parameter taking
the generic collection type, if any, into account.
items.translation: 确定给定参数的约定变量名，如有泛型集合类型，请予以考虑。
